prompt: This repository already has Playwright smoke tests, but agents still cannot reliably launch the app, verify the current checkout, drive the affected user path, preserve evidence, and clean up. Add the missing project verification lifecycle without replacing the existing Playwright harness.
scenario: An existing test harness is a drive primitive, not a competing lifecycle owner. Reuse it and add only the missing verification contract.

prompt: Agents keep writing a new temporary Playwright or Node script every time they need to navigate and debug this app. The repository already has Playwright and stable launch primitives. Create or repair the project verifier so future agents reuse a persistent agent-facing control interface instead of recreating the same clicks and inspection logic per task.
scenario: Repeated verification interaction is encoded as a durable existing command surface or the smallest verifier-owned helper, while Playwright remains the underlying drive primitive rather than being replaced.
